name: École normale supérieure-PSL (Paris)
header:
École normale supérieure-PSL (Paris)
France · International Selection in Mathematics → master + DENS; CNE alternative; later PSL doctorate
Relevant European programme; no numerical ranking asserted
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• SI 2027 deadline is 15 December 2026 at 14:00 Paris, despite erroneous year in one table.
• SI mathematics has no humanities research-proposal requirement.
• The funded three-year SI master/DENS route does not itself admit you to a doctorate.
• Housing is charged and dormitories close in August; grant payment starts in October.
• Faculty shortlist covers closest DMA matches, not all PSL institutions; availability is not promised.
• ENS/PSL academic admission precedes EEF pre-consular processing; do not apply Sorbonne/Strasbourg’s
January EEF academic deadline indiscriminately.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [2027 confirmed]
SI Sciences: potentially eligible with UChicago study, subject to age under 26 on opening day; at least one
foreign university year completed when applying and two at enrolment; no previous SI attempt; French
secondary/higher-education registration no more than six months total during the competition academic year
and preceding year. Exceptional cases require director approval. Master/DENS entry, not a bachelor-to-PhD
offer. Later doctorate needs M2/equivalent and an HDR supervisor. Age and prior France study remain
unverified. [s1] [s9]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Choose Mathematics in SI and request referees through OnePSL30. CNE is a separate alternative; exceptional
M1-level entry requires checking department placement. SI selection includes remote scientific and motivation
interviews; use the FAQ and prior jury reports to prepare. Campus France does not transmit SI applications;
visa processing follows admission. For ordinary ENS/PSL master admission, PSL also directs applicants to the
academic portal first, then EEF pre-consular processing after acceptance. Dauphine-hosted programmes are
the stated exception requiring both portals. Do not import the January EEF full-admissions deadline into ENS
International Selection. [s1] [s2] [s6] [s26]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
SI does not require a prior supervisor agreement; department assigns a tutor in August/September. Later
doctorate requires an HDR-qualified supervisor belonging to the chosen doctoral school. Shortlist below
emphasizes DMA matches, with joint/temporary postings flagged. [s2] [s9] [s11]
Portal workflow [Conflict]
Use OnePSL30, attachments, no email/postal applications. The public SI page also retains an inconsistent older
instruction to merge everything into one PDF after an initial form; follow current portal and ask admissions
about attachment packaging without uploading confidential references yourself. [s1] [s2] [s19]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
SI 2027 confirmed by signed 17 September 2026 decree. CNE/master excellence/doctoral contracts currently
only 2026 calendars. PGSM 2027 deadline confirmed on its application landing page. [s3] [s6] [s8] [s9] [s18]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
SI: 16 October 2026, 14:00 to 15 December 2026, 14:00 Paris time. Signed calendar controls the website typo.
Shortlist from 27 January 2027; test invitations 28 January-2 March; interviews 3-19 March; results from 26
March. CNE 2027 not published: previous cycle 9 March-24 April 2026, 14:00 (page does not separately specify
timezone). The separate EEF January deadline is not an ENS SI deadline; ENS uses its own competition,
followed by pre-consular formalities if needed. [s1] [s3] [s6] [s26]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
SI grant follows the SI competition deadline. Separate PGSM 2027 closes 22 January 2027, 23:59 Paris. PSL
master excellence 2027 dates unposted: 2026 pure-math deadline was 25 May 2026. PSL doctoral contract
2026 deadline was 4 May 2026, 23:30, timezone unspecified; no 2027 confirmation. [s3] [s8] [s9] [s18]
Reference receipt [2027 confirmed]
SI requires a complete dossier by 15 December 2026, 14:00 Paris; no separate grace period published. CNE
2027 and separate scholarship letter deadlines unresolved. PGSM standing FAQ allows referees two extra days
after the applicant deadline; no explicitly dated 2027 clock/time was found, so confirm the actual cutoff. [s1]
[s3] [s23] [s25]
Test-score receipt [Unresolved]
No standardized score deadline listed for SI; confirm any applicant-specific request in the portal. [s1]
Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
SI complete dossier at the application deadline. Administrative registration September 2027; admitted
applicants receive the final certified-document list in spring. [s1] [s3]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No public SI acceptance-response date found. Follow the offer; results from 26 March 2027 do not establish a
commitment deadline. [s1]

are available; pure-math M1 teaching is French in the PSL grant notice. [s2] [s8]

curriculum or waive any separate master requirement. [s2]

accepted or reviewed. [s1]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
SI: 2-4. CNE: two referees per department. [s1] [s6]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
SI uses its admission references for the integrated grant. PSL doctoral-contract application additionally requires
the intended thesis director’s commitment letter (2026 rule). PGSM separately requires one to three academic
recommendations; no additional distinct questionnaire beyond that range was established. [s1] [s9] [s21] [s23]
What sends the invitation [Unresolved]
SI tells applicants to enter referees’ emails in OnePSL30 to request letters; public wording does not establish
whether saving an address immediately sends the message or whether a send button is required. Avoid iCloud
addresses. PGSM automatically emails professors during application completion/validation; the FAQ does not
resolve whether saving the email before first validation alone triggers it. [s1] [s2] [s23] [s25]
Before versus after submission [Unresolved]
No public statement that SI invitations wait for final submission; verify trigger in OnePSL30 before finalizing.
PGSM first-validation confirmation contains a recommendation-upload link that can be forwarded to additional
referees or those missing the automated email. [s19] [s23] [s25]
Receipt confirmation [Unresolved]
Applicant must verify completeness; public pages do not document the exact receipt-status indicator. Check
portal and contact concours.international@ens.psl.eu for missing status. PGSM applicants can see
submitted-letter status in the dossier but cannot read/delete letters. [s2] [s4] [s19] [s23] [s25]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
Letter replacement, reuse and referee editing after submission are not documented publicly; confirm in
OnePSL30. PGSM permits completion/additional references after first validation; applicants cannot delete
letters, and referee replacement/update or cross-year reuse is not stated. [s19] [s23] [s25]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
SI CV required as attachment; no public length/format beyond upload instructions. CNE and PSL
doctoral-contract CV also required. [s1] [s6] [s9]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
SI cover letter required, 1-3 pages, Times New Roman 12 pt, 1.5 spacing, French or English. Faithful prompt
paraphrase: explain ENS/department choice and briefly present interests, planned courses, research themes
and possible secondary discipline. Upload. CNE motivation letter required, public length unspecified. [s1] [s6]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
No separate SI personal/background statement specified. Personal motivation belongs in the cover letter; no
extra upload permission established. [s1]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
SI research themes belong within the cover letter; no standalone statement specified. [s1]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
SI Sciences does not list the humanities three-page/10,000-character proposal. Do not apply humanities rules

to mathematics. Later PSL doctoral contract requires a brief thesis project; 2026 notice gives no numeric limit.
[s1] [s2] [s9]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
SI has no separate published sample requirement. CNE explicitly welcomes relevant internship
reports/personal work combined in one file within portal size limits (numeric size unpublished). Upload rather
than merely link under that instruction. [s1] [s5]
Publications list [Unresolved]
No separate SI publications-list requirement or paper-upload rule published. Ask before using additional
attachments. [s1]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
No standalone SI mathematics-course-list essay required in published checklist. Planned courses belong in the
cover letter. [s1]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
SI has no separate grant essay. Other PSL master grant portal prompts are not public. Doctoral-contract
packet: CV, motivation, director commitment, brief project, available M2 grades in one PDF; complete the
separate form too (2026 rule). PGSM separately asks CV, motivation letter, academic records, one-to-three
recommendations and selection of one-to-three eligible programmes; no public motivation word/page limit or
separate financial-need essay was established. ENS-PSL is an eligible partner; this does not make Saclay
eligible. [s8] [s9] [s21] [s22]
Other short answers / materials [Prior cycle]
CNE 2026 mathematics assessment: first 30-minute oral begins with a 15-minute presentation of a chosen
mathematical result, then questions; second 30-minute oral covers background, motivation and a jury
problem. SI test format differs and is set by department. [s5] [s2]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
SI €1,000/month for 36 months (€12,000 per full 12-month year, arithmetic). Room access is not free housing;
rent TBD and August closure. PSL master 2026 grant €1,200/month for ten months (€12,000 total), conditional
second-year renewal. PSL doctorate 2026 indicative gross €2,300/month (€27,600/12 months, arithmetic),
registration fees still payable. No 2027 PhD salary confirmed. Separate PGSM published rate is €1,150/month:
M1 first year €13,800/12 months; M2 €12,650/11 months, or €13,800 with the specified twelfth-month
condition (totals calculated). Published rules include registration/social coverage, CROUS housing reservation
and annual economy home-country return travel for international recipients; a reservation is not free rent. Do
not assume combination with ENS SI is allowed. [s2] [s4] [s8] [s9] [s21] [s22]
Years of support [Standing rule]
SI three funded years, payment suspended during approved gaps. PSL master grant one year, renewal
application/conditions for second. Doctoral contracts three years (2026 call). PGSM M1 second year is 11/12
months after successful exams; M2 twelfth month requires continuation to a French doctorate or internship
through August. Award starts 1 September and presence is required. [s2] [s8] [s9] [s22]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
SI is expressly an international selection. PSL master and doctoral calls admit international candidates. F-1
status itself is not French residence permission; citizenship and visa requirements need individual checking.
PGSM international call is for students studying outside France; UChicago meets that location condition, subject
to other call rules. [s4] [s8] [s9] [s21]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
SI requires DENS plus master, including 72 additional ECTS; no civil-servant ten-year service obligation. French

bank account required. First payment October covers September/October. Later PhD funding depends on
separate selection and doctoral-school registration. [s1] [s2] [s9]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
SI award is integrated. PSL master excellence is a separate MyCandidature application; doctoral contracts
require form plus emailed single PDF. CNE mathematics advertises grants for female laureates and other
laureates subject to available funds; do not assume John receives one. PGSM is an independent application and
scholarship selection does not itself enrol the student in the master. [s5] [s8] [s9] [s21] [s22]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
PGSM is a separate potential master award at partner institutions. CNE graduates may compete for specific
normalien doctoral contracts. PSL’s five-year master-to-PhD description is an academic pathway, not a
five-year funding guarantee. [s5] [s7] [s18]
Application fee [Unresolved]
SI application fee not established publicly. Registration fees are required but FAQ amount is awaiting update.
Do not label application free from silence. For an accepted US-resident applicant who needs Campus France
pre-consular processing, the regular charge is US$270; US$460 is the different full-admissions route and must
not be added automatically to ENS SI. Waiver/visa costs remain situation-dependent. [s2] [s19] [s20] [s24] [s26]
Fee waiver [Unresolved]
No public SI fee-waiver procedure found. Confirm whether any application charge exists before considering
waiver logistics. [s19]

sections.title: Conflicts and remaining checks
sections.text:
Conflicting sources [Conflict]
SI table says October-December 2027 but header, deadline prose and signed decree say 2026: use signed
decree. One-PDF versus attachment guidance conflicts. FAQ says CNE brings no grant, whereas mathematics
department advertises specific grants: department-specific funding is conditional. Mehmeti’s ENS posting runs
September 2024-September 2027; confirm location for autumn 2027 supervision. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s5] [s16]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Before drafting: verify age/French-study history/previous SI attempt, entry placement, portal file packaging and
size, referee trigger/receipt/replacement, application fee, offer-response date, and 2027 CNE/master/doctoral
grant calendars. Ask about French-language readiness and each researcher’s 2027 availability. Confirm PGSM
letter cutoff, exact portal writing limits and whether any award can be combined with ENS SI/other grants. [s1]
[s2] [s19] [s21] [s23]

text:
École normale supérieure-PSL (Paris)
France · International Selection in Mathematics → master + DENS; CNE alternative; later PSL doctorate
Relevant European programme; no numerical ranking asserted
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• SI 2027 deadline is 15 December 2026 at 14:00 Paris, despite erroneous year in one table.
• SI mathematics has no humanities research-proposal requirement.
• The funded three-year SI master/DENS route does not itself admit you to a doctorate.
• Housing is charged and dormitories close in August; grant payment starts in October.
• Faculty shortlist covers closest DMA matches, not all PSL institutions; availability is not promised.
• ENS/PSL academic admission precedes EEF pre-consular processing; do not apply Sorbonne/Strasbourg’s
January EEF academic deadline indiscriminately.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [2027 confirmed]
SI Sciences: potentially eligible with UChicago study, subject to age under 26 on opening day; at least one
foreign university year completed when applying and two at enrolment; no previous SI attempt; French
secondary/higher-education registration no more than six months total during the competition academic year
and preceding year. Exceptional cases require director approval. Master/DENS entry, not a bachelor-to-PhD
offer. Later doctorate needs M2/equivalent and an HDR supervisor. Age and prior France study remain
unverified. [s1] [s9]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Choose Mathematics in SI and request referees through OnePSL30. CNE is a separate alternative; exceptional
M1-level entry requires checking department placement. SI selection includes remote scientific and motivation
interviews; use the FAQ and prior jury reports to prepare. Campus France does not transmit SI applications;
visa processing follows admission. For ordinary ENS/PSL master admission, PSL also directs applicants to the
academic portal first, then EEF pre-consular processing after acceptance. Dauphine-hosted programmes are
the stated exception requiring both portals. Do not import the January EEF full-admissions deadline into ENS
International Selection. [s1] [s2] [s6] [s26]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
SI does not require a prior supervisor agreement; department assigns a tutor in August/September. Later
doctorate requires an HDR-qualified supervisor belonging to the chosen doctoral school. Shortlist below
emphasizes DMA matches, with joint/temporary postings flagged. [s2] [s9] [s11]
Portal workflow [Conflict]
Use OnePSL30, attachments, no email/postal applications. The public SI page also retains an inconsistent older
instruction to merge everything into one PDF after an initial form; follow current portal and ask admissions
about attachment packaging without uploading confidential references yourself. [s1] [s2] [s19]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
SI 2027 confirmed by signed 17 September 2026 decree. CNE/master excellence/doctoral contracts currently
only 2026 calendars. PGSM 2027 deadline confirmed on its application landing page. [s3] [s6] [s8] [s9] [s18]

Deadlines by stage
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
SI: 16 October 2026, 14:00 to 15 December 2026, 14:00 Paris time. Signed calendar controls the website typo.
Shortlist from 27 January 2027; test invitations 28 January-2 March; interviews 3-19 March; results from 26
March. CNE 2027 not published: previous cycle 9 March-24 April 2026, 14:00 (page does not separately specify
timezone). The separate EEF January deadline is not an ENS SI deadline; ENS uses its own competition,
followed by pre-consular formalities if needed. [s1] [s3] [s6] [s26]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
SI grant follows the SI competition deadline. Separate PGSM 2027 closes 22 January 2027, 23:59 Paris. PSL
master excellence 2027 dates unposted: 2026 pure-math deadline was 25 May 2026. PSL doctoral contract
2026 deadline was 4 May 2026, 23:30, timezone unspecified; no 2027 confirmation. [s3] [s8] [s9] [s18]
Reference receipt [2027 confirmed]
SI requires a complete dossier by 15 December 2026, 14:00 Paris; no separate grace period published. CNE
2027 and separate scholarship letter deadlines unresolved. PGSM standing FAQ allows referees two extra days
after the applicant deadline; no explicitly dated 2027 clock/time was found, so confirm the actual cutoff. [s1]
[s3] [s23] [s25]
Test-score receipt [Unresolved]
No standardized score deadline listed for SI; confirm any applicant-specific request in the portal. [s1]
Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
SI complete dossier at the application deadline. Administrative registration September 2027; admitted
applicants receive the final certified-document list in spring. [s1] [s3]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No public SI acceptance-response date found. Follow the offer; results from 26 March 2027 do not establish a
commitment deadline. [s1]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
SI Sciences has no officially prescribed language level. Interviews may be in French or English. French lessons
are available; pure-math M1 teaching is French in the PSL grant notice. [s2] [s8]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
No UChicago-specific waiver needed under the SI rule above; this does not establish an English-taught
curriculum or waive any separate master requirement. [s2]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Not listed among SI required documents. Public evidence does not say whether unsolicited GRE uploads are
accepted or reviewed. [s1]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Not listed among SI required documents; the competition has its own mathematics assessment. Unsolicited
score policy unverified. [s1]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
SI: high-school diploma and university transcript. Accepted record languages: French/English, also
Spanish/Italian/Portuguese. CNE additionally requests academic results since the baccalauréat, including
baccalauréat and relevant entrance-exam results. Later doctoral contract asks available M2 grades. [s1] [s2] [s6]
[s9]

Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
No separate SI mathematics-course spreadsheet specified. [s1]
Course descriptions [Unresolved]
No distinct SI course-description requirement published; portal-specific requests remain to be checked. [s1]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
SI: 2-4. CNE: two referees per department. [s1] [s6]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
SI uses its admission references for the integrated grant. PSL doctoral-contract application additionally requires
the intended thesis director’s commitment letter (2026 rule). PGSM separately requires one to three academic
recommendations; no additional distinct questionnaire beyond that range was established. [s1] [s9] [s21] [s23]
What sends the invitation [Unresolved]
SI tells applicants to enter referees’ emails in OnePSL30 to request letters; public wording does not establish
whether saving an address immediately sends the message or whether a send button is required. Avoid iCloud
addresses. PGSM automatically emails professors during application completion/validation; the FAQ does not
resolve whether saving the email before first validation alone triggers it. [s1] [s2] [s23] [s25]
Before versus after submission [Unresolved]
No public statement that SI invitations wait for final submission; verify trigger in OnePSL30 before finalizing.
PGSM first-validation confirmation contains a recommendation-upload link that can be forwarded to additional
referees or those missing the automated email. [s19] [s23] [s25]
Receipt confirmation [Unresolved]
Applicant must verify completeness; public pages do not document the exact receipt-status indicator. Check
portal and contact concours.international@ens.psl.eu for missing status. PGSM applicants can see
submitted-letter status in the dossier but cannot read/delete letters. [s2] [s4] [s19] [s23] [s25]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
Letter replacement, reuse and referee editing after submission are not documented publicly; confirm in
OnePSL30. PGSM permits completion/additional references after first validation; applicants cannot delete
letters, and referee replacement/update or cross-year reuse is not stated. [s19] [s23] [s25]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
SI CV required as attachment; no public length/format beyond upload instructions. CNE and PSL
doctoral-contract CV also required. [s1] [s6] [s9]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
SI cover letter required, 1-3 pages, Times New Roman 12 pt, 1.5 spacing, French or English. Faithful prompt
paraphrase: explain ENS/department choice and briefly present interests, planned courses, research themes
and possible secondary discipline. Upload. CNE motivation letter required, public length unspecified. [s1] [s6]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
No separate SI personal/background statement specified. Personal motivation belongs in the cover letter; no
extra upload permission established. [s1]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
SI research themes belong within the cover letter; no standalone statement specified. [s1]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
SI Sciences does not list the humanities three-page/10,000-character proposal. Do not apply humanities rules

to mathematics. Later PSL doctoral contract requires a brief thesis project; 2026 notice gives no numeric limit.
[s1] [s2] [s9]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
SI has no separate published sample requirement. CNE explicitly welcomes relevant internship
reports/personal work combined in one file within portal size limits (numeric size unpublished). Upload rather
than merely link under that instruction. [s1] [s5]
Publications list [Unresolved]
No separate SI publications-list requirement or paper-upload rule published. Ask before using additional
attachments. [s1]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
No standalone SI mathematics-course-list essay required in published checklist. Planned courses belong in the
cover letter. [s1]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
SI has no separate grant essay. Other PSL master grant portal prompts are not public. Doctoral-contract
packet: CV, motivation, director commitment, brief project, available M2 grades in one PDF; complete the
separate form too (2026 rule). PGSM separately asks CV, motivation letter, academic records, one-to-three
recommendations and selection of one-to-three eligible programmes; no public motivation word/page limit or
separate financial-need essay was established. ENS-PSL is an eligible partner; this does not make Saclay
eligible. [s8] [s9] [s21] [s22]
Other short answers / materials [Prior cycle]
CNE 2026 mathematics assessment: first 30-minute oral begins with a 15-minute presentation of a chosen
mathematical result, then questions; second 30-minute oral covers background, motivation and a jury
problem. SI test format differs and is set by department. [s5] [s2]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
SI €1,000/month for 36 months (€12,000 per full 12-month year, arithmetic). Room access is not free housing;
rent TBD and August closure. PSL master 2026 grant €1,200/month for ten months (€12,000 total), conditional
second-year renewal. PSL doctorate 2026 indicative gross €2,300/month (€27,600/12 months, arithmetic),
registration fees still payable. No 2027 PhD salary confirmed. Separate PGSM published rate is €1,150/month:
M1 first year €13,800/12 months; M2 €12,650/11 months, or €13,800 with the specified twelfth-month
condition (totals calculated). Published rules include registration/social coverage, CROUS housing reservation
and annual economy home-country return travel for international recipients; a reservation is not free rent. Do
not assume combination with ENS SI is allowed. [s2] [s4] [s8] [s9] [s21] [s22]
Years of support [Standing rule]
SI three funded years, payment suspended during approved gaps. PSL master grant one year, renewal
application/conditions for second. Doctoral contracts three years (2026 call). PGSM M1 second year is 11/12
months after successful exams; M2 twelfth month requires continuation to a French doctorate or internship
through August. Award starts 1 September and presence is required. [s2] [s8] [s9] [s22]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
SI is expressly an international selection. PSL master and doctoral calls admit international candidates. F-1
status itself is not French residence permission; citizenship and visa requirements need individual checking.
PGSM international call is for students studying outside France; UChicago meets that location condition, subject
to other call rules. [s4] [s8] [s9] [s21]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
SI requires DENS plus master, including 72 additional ECTS; no civil-servant ten-year service obligation. French

bank account required. First payment October covers September/October. Later PhD funding depends on
separate selection and doctoral-school registration. [s1] [s2] [s9]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
SI award is integrated. PSL master excellence is a separate MyCandidature application; doctoral contracts
require form plus emailed single PDF. CNE mathematics advertises grants for female laureates and other
laureates subject to available funds; do not assume John receives one. PGSM is an independent application and
scholarship selection does not itself enrol the student in the master. [s5] [s8] [s9] [s21] [s22]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
PGSM is a separate potential master award at partner institutions. CNE graduates may compete for specific
normalien doctoral contracts. PSL’s five-year master-to-PhD description is an academic pathway, not a
five-year funding guarantee. [s5] [s7] [s18]
Application fee [Unresolved]
SI application fee not established publicly. Registration fees are required but FAQ amount is awaiting update.
Do not label application free from silence. For an accepted US-resident applicant who needs Campus France
pre-consular processing, the regular charge is US$270; US$460 is the different full-admissions route and must
not be added automatically to ENS SI. Waiver/visa costs remain situation-dependent. [s2] [s19] [s20] [s24] [s26]
Fee waiver [Unresolved]
No public SI fee-waiver procedure found. Confirm whether any application charge exists before considering
waiver logistics. [s19]
Conflicts and remaining checks
Conflicting sources [Conflict]
SI table says October-December 2027 but header, deadline prose and signed decree say 2026: use signed
decree. One-PDF versus attachment guidance conflicts. FAQ says CNE brings no grant, whereas mathematics
department advertises specific grants: department-specific funding is conditional. Mehmeti’s ENS posting runs
September 2024-September 2027; confirm location for autumn 2027 supervision. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s5] [s16]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Before drafting: verify age/French-study history/previous SI attempt, entry placement, portal file packaging and
size, referee trigger/receipt/replacement, application fee, offer-response date, and 2027 CNE/master/doctoral
grant calendars. Ask about French-language readiness and each researcher’s 2027 availability. Confirm PGSM
letter cutoff, exact portal writing limits and whether any award can be combined with ENS SI/other grants. [s1]
